exposure.needed: which Kafka clusters in the environment are still ZooKeeper-based rather than KRaft-based

consequence.statement: All Kafka clusters must be using KRaft before upgrading to Strimzi 0.46.0 or newer; ZooKeeper-based clusters and the migration from ZooKeeper-based clusters to KRaft are no longer supported, so an environment with ZooKeeper-based clusters must migrate them to KRaft before the upgrade.
consequence.remediation: Migrate every ZooKeeper-based Kafka cluster to KRaft before upgrading to Strimzi 0.46.0 or newer (the ZooKeeper-to-KRaft migration path is also removed in 0.46.0, so it cannot be done after upgrading).

assertion.statement: Strimzi 0.46.0 removes support for ZooKeeper-based Kafka clusters and for migration from ZooKeeper-based clusters to KRaft; operators must make sure all their clusters are using KRaft before upgrading to Strimzi 0.46.0 or newer.
